body:
A separate W02 technical review found a version-type limitation in the reviewed private crosswalk helper. At `crosswalk.py` SHA256 `6b247656ec34a5280a7b10ba1dea6a67edfc12fa0aab004cbb2ec9575a650753`, retirement-statement validation compares the decoded dictionary with an expected dictionary containing integer schema_version1. Native JSON decoding plus Python equality treats `true` and `1.0` as equal to1; the string"1" and null are refused.

This is a confirmed comparator observation, not a demonstrated complete accepted-crosswalk or source-application bypass. Exact evidence: `workers/w02/worktree/.temp/ebios-no-install-v1/technical/native-retirement-version-type-observation-v1.json`, SHA256 `c0204beecdd68edfffd668d22a6175e3825117737d743e6f4a5372fe22c6bec8`. No helper fix has been made. The actual EBIOS retirement statement uses integer1, and its author-level verifier explicitly checks the type. Do not alter or delay that valid source statement merely because of these diagnostic alternatives.

Bounded follow-up: reproduce through the real retirement validation path, explicitly require the documented integer version (excluding bool and float), and retain strict full-object equality, genuine original/successor hashes, publication ancestry and case/evidence contracts. Add meaningful negative controls for both invalid decoded types, preserve existing controls and exact original helper/review evidence, and independently review a new helper revision before the final campaign crosswalk uses it. No source disposition, scientific hold or application authority changes.
